description: Stand up the full gabMileage Aspire solution (AppHost, ServiceDefaults, Api, Gateway, Web, test projects) and implement the WorkOS authentication flow at the YARP Gateway so users can sign in/out, establish a cookie-based session, and land on an inviting empty-garage dashboard with consistent loading/error states.

tasks.title: Scaffold Aspire solution + local orchestration
tasks.description: Create/verify the required solution structure and Aspire AppHost wiring so the stack runs locally with production-parity config. Required projects/resources: `gabMileage.AppHost` (Aspire), `gabMileage.ServiceDefaults`, `gabMileage.Api` (ASP.NET Core + Marten + Wolverine + NodaTime), `gabMileage.Gateway` (YARP reverse proxy), `gabMileage.Web` (TanStack Start Node app), plus test projects under `tests/`. In AppHost, provision Postgres + database, Redis, then start Api, Web, and Gateway. Use explicit env-var mapping (no Aspire service discovery in app code): Gateway gets `ReverseProxy__Clusters__api__Destinations__d1__Address` and `...web...` destination addresses from AppHost; Web receives `GABMILEAGE_BASE_URL` pointing at the browser-facing Gateway URL so server-side loaders can fetch `/api/*` via an absolute base. Ensure each service exposes `/health` and `/alive` endpoints (dev-only is fine) so Aspire can report healthy resources.
acceptanceCriteria: Solution builds locally and `dotnet run --project gabMileage.AppHost` starts Postgres, Redis, Api, Gateway, and Web
Aspire shows Api/Gateway/Web resources with passing HTTP health checks on `/health`
Gateway routes browser traffic to Web and proxies `/api/v1/*` to Api using config under `ReverseProxy`

tasks.title: ServiceDefaults: observability + health guardrails
tasks.description: Implement `gabMileage.ServiceDefaults` and apply it to Api and Gateway. Standardize: structured logging, OpenTelemetry (traces/logs/metrics as configured), and health checks. Add a startup validation guard so services fail fast when mandatory health checks/configuration are missing (e.g., enforce that required health checks exist). Keep the configuration portable so services can run without Aspire by providing config purely via normal .NET configuration sources (env vars/appsettings/user-secrets).
acceptanceCriteria: Api and Gateway call `builder.AddServiceDefaults()` and expose `/health` and `/alive`
Requests flowing Web → Gateway → Api emit trace spans visible in Aspire when OTEL endpoint is configured
A service fails startup when required health checks are absent (guardrail behavior)

tasks.title: Api baseline: Marten + Wolverine + User provisioning read model
tasks.description: In `gabMileage.Api`, configure Marten with PostgreSQL as the event store and Wolverine for command handling. Enforce time conventions with NodaTime: `Instant` for timestamps and `LocalDate` for user-facing dates; configure System.Text.Json to serialize them as ISO strings (per contract). Implement the Users vertical slice with: Wolverine command `ProvisionUser { userId, displayName, email, avatarUrl }` (idempotent), domain event `UserProvisioned { userId, displayName, email, avatarUrl, occurredAt }`, and a Marten projection that builds a `UserProfile` read model keyed by `userId`. In Development, make schema creation/migration self-healing (auto-create + apply changes on startup) while keeping production-safe defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: Marten is configured with `StreamIdentity.AsString` and Npgsql NodaTime mappings enabled
First-time provisioning persists `UserProvisioned` and `UserProfile` becomes queryable by `userId`
JSON serialization outputs ISO-8601 strings for `Instant` and `LocalDate` (no custom numeric formats)

tasks.title: Gateway.Auth: WorkOS hosted auth + secure cookie session
tasks.description: In `gabMileage.Gateway`, implement the browser-facing auth flow owned by the Gateway (not the frontend, not the Api). Add endpoints: `GET /api/auth/login?returnTo=/...` (validates `returnTo` is a safe relative URL and 302-redirects to WorkOS hosted auth), `GET /api/auth/callback` (exchanges the WorkOS authorization code for a JWT, validates it, sets `gab_session` as `HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Lax; Path=/`, provisions the user by calling/commanding the Api, then redirects to `/auth/redirect?returnTo=...`), and `POST /api/auth/logout` (clears cookie(s) and 303-redirects to `/login`). Implement refresh-before-expiry so near-expiring sessions are refreshed transparently; on refresh failure or invalid token, clear cookies and treat the request as unauthenticated. Protect `/api/v1/*` on the proxy pipeline via ASP.NET Core auth middleware + authorization.
acceptanceCriteria: `/api/auth/login` validates `returnTo` is relative (no scheme/host) and issues an HTTP redirect to WorkOS
Successful callback sets `gab_session` with HttpOnly+Secure+SameSite=Lax and redirects to `/auth/redirect` with `returnTo` preserved
`POST /api/auth/logout` clears session cookie(s) and redirects with `303 See Other` to `/login`
Proxy routes for `/api/v1/*` require authorization; XHR/fetch 401 responses are `application/problem+json` (not HTML redirects)

tasks.title: Api auth boundary: Gateway-forwarded identity + initial endpoints
tasks.description: Establish a clean auth boundary between Gateway and Api. The Gateway forwards identity to the Api as `X-User-Id: {workosUserId}` derived from the JWT `sub` claim (optionally with a signature header for spoofing defense). In the Api, implement an authentication scheme/handler that trusts the forwarded identity only when it matches the expected trust configuration, then populate `ClaimsPrincipal` with `sub` and provide an `AuthContext` for handlers. Implement Sprint 01 endpoints: `GET /api/v1/me` (returns persisted `UserProfile`), `GET /api/v1/garage/summary` (returns `{ userId, vehicles: [] }` in this sprint), and `POST /api/v1/users/provision` (internal, invoked by Gateway after successful WorkOS callback). Enforce: all `/api/v1/*` endpoints require auth (401 when missing/invalid).
acceptanceCriteria: Api derives `AuthContext.UserId` from the authenticated principal (`sub`) created from Gateway-forwarded headers
`GET /api/v1/me` returns 200 with user profile for provisioned user, 404 if missing profile, 401 if unauthenticated
`GET /api/v1/garage/summary` returns `vehicles: []` for the current user and requires auth

tasks.title: Web.Auth + shell + empty-garage dashboard (warm UX)
tasks.description: In `gabMileage.Web` (TanStack Start), implement the user-facing auth and initial app shell. Routes: `/login` (single primary button `Sign in` that navigates to `GET /api/auth/login` with an optional returnTo), `/auth/redirect` (stable loading screen text `Signing you in…` while client fetches bootstrap data, then navigates to `returnTo`), and `/auth/error` (friendly error state with retry/sign-in again). Implement an authenticated layout with a top bar (`data-testid=topbar`) showing wordmark left and a user menu trigger (`data-testid=user-menu-trigger`) with avatar/name right; menu includes `Sign out` which calls `POST /api/auth/logout` and returns to the login screen. Implement dashboard `/` that fetches `GET /api/v1/me` and `GET /api/v1/garage/summary`, shows skeletons while loading, shows a retryable error state, and renders the empty garage state (`data-testid=empty-garage-state`) with heading `Your garage is empty` and a `+ Add Vehicle` CTA (route can be a placeholder until Sprint 02). Ensure 401 handling is consistent: any 401 from `/api/v1/*` should route the user to `/login` without flashing the wrong state.
acceptanceCriteria: Unauthenticated visit to `/` shows the login screen (`data-testid=login-screen`) and a single Sign in button
`/auth/redirect` renders a stable loading screen (`data-testid=auth-redirect-screen`) with “Signing you in…”
Authenticated user sees the top bar and empty garage state with heading + “+ Add Vehicle” CTA
Dashboard uses skeleton/loading states and does not flash empty vs populated state during fetch

tasks.title: Verification: unit tests + Vitest + Playwright E2E smoke
tasks.description: Make the sprint verifiable via automated tests. Backend: add/maintain xUnit+Shouldly unit tests that assert scaffold requirements (projects exist, reverse proxy config present, NodaTime serialization configured) and auth flow behaviors in Gateway (login/callback/logout endpoints, cookie flags, RequireAuthorization, X-User-Id forwarding). Frontend: add/maintain Vitest tests for any shared UI utilities if needed. E2E: Playwright specs should cover (1) unauthenticated user sees login at `/`, (2) auth redirect route shows loading screen, and (3) an optional smoke that logs in through real WorkOS hosted UI when credentials are provided via env vars. Ensure Playwright runs without recording traces/video by default to avoid credential leakage.
acceptanceCriteria: `dotnet test` passes for backend unit tests (scaffold + gateway auth flow expectations)
`npm test` passes in `gabMileage.Web` (Vitest) if UI tests exist for this sprint
Playwright includes a login→dashboard smoke that is safely skipped when required env vars are not set, and asserts empty garage heading + CTA
